comments: 636c7922: This program is responsible for printing various reports related to the VA system.
c75583a6: Iterate through each division and generate reports based on patient or date.
37279c90: Exit the report generation if an error occurs or continue to the next report part.
d369f82d: Exit the program and return to the calling routine.
6df5e732: Set the current division for report processing.
d371b161: Retrieve and display the division name from the hospital location file.
0c4b0f31: Placeholder comment not needed; indicates the end of a code block.
6dfbbb5f: Format and display the date on the report.
e7f8cbc4: Loop through each patient within the current division for report data.
b5bc8a8d: End of the patient loop.
f875333d: For each patient, loop through their associated records and print details.
124d8136: End of the detailed patient record loop.
f1034ebb: Display the header for the physician section if not already displayed.
3b5c42c9: Loop through each physician within the current division and process their patients.
c17d5ba7: End of the physician loop.
7f8b8cf8: For each physician, process each patient and print their details.
b56b717c: End of the physician-patient detail loop.
b8218210: Loop through dates to process records in date order.
b9c0e9fc: End of the date loop.
b98ff8be: For each date, loop through patients and print their record details.
ebfbd5ab: End of the detailed date record loop.
3e1536fc: Display the header for the service section if not already displayed.
a7655fee: Loop through each service within the current division and process specialty reports.
0ba2dcfb: End of the service loop.
d6617db5: For each service, loop through specialties and process reports.
11a131f6: End of the service-specialty detail loop.
33a4e404: For each specialty, process each patient and print their details.
7a193eb9: End of the specialty-patient detail loop.
713ebdf3: Set up for printing the details of a patient's record.
7f8b1ef5: Determine and print the physician's name associated with the record.
dae82564: If sorting by date, print the date at the beginning of the line.
51eb941d: If not sorting by date, simply start a new line.
bba8e23d: Print the first 15 characters of the patient's name.
21784192: Print the patient identifier based on the sort order.
b6ced931: If not sorting by date, print the date of the event.
49c3e337: Print the discharge type if available.
9c12b016: Print the associated clinic name if available.
7e9bee6f: Set variables for record tracking and print the latest record information.
9fdea31a: Print the last action taken on the record.
19d96c17: If sorting by physician, include header information specific to physicians.
75ab1882: Print the physician's name.
8ce9250a: Print the service connected to the record.
86a83609: If directive is to print details, include additional status information.
dae8a684: Print the length of the delay for the record.
60e3f8fe: End of the print procedure for a single record.
d6ea2b92: Invoke the header printing routine from another program part.
8de076eb: Handle a return action for patient or date sorting when not using a CRT display.
a14f80e5: Check if the output device is not a CRT; if so, do nothing.
00037f32: Advance to a new page on the report if needed.
c995fca9: Display division information again if outputting to a CRT display.
acc1a619: Prompt the user to continue or quit during report pagination.
69ee2bb5: Prepare for a new page if nearing the end and sorting by patient or date.
247bc31b: Prepare for a new page if nearing the end, applicable to all sort orders.
950b3234: End of the pagination check routine.
46d6f0f0: Print the division header for the current report section.
c3bd9377: Print the physician's name as a header for their report section.
9b900e45: Print the service name as a header for its report section.
b5e1125d: Print the specialty name as a header for its report section.
4836a5ad: Delegate to another routine for printing physician-specific headers.
65513825: Delegate to another routine for printing service-specific headers.
